plain_description.what: Re-testing, on a 20-model board with three times as many model pairs, an earlier finding about the judge's errors. The finding was that orderings between near-tied models are disproportionately wrong, while orderings across clear tiers are error-free.
plain_description.why: The budget line rested on that finding, so it needed replication.
plain_description.information: Result (no new calls, corrected): only partly replicated. Overconfidence on near-tied pairs and one specific inversion (arx vs iask) replicate. 'Near-tied orderings are disproportionately wrong' does not (1 of 6 vs 4 of 176 once a stricter test is applied). 'Across-tier is error-free' holds on the original roster but fails on added models. The earlier dramatic headline is superseded. It is on older judged data now ruled history.
